notes: MDF adapts the upstream build command into a Codex-native model-led TDD and focused-commit entrypoint.
adapterRationale: The upstream command is converted into a model-led entrypoint that preserves canonical cards, locks, TDD, review, task-owned paths, and explicit risk stops.
reviewRisk: Full adapter replacement can hide upstream build command changes; validation pins the upstream command hash and requires explicit review when it changes.
